note: New strings of the Settings › Data integrity page (P1-C06). The page falls back to the English text below when the key is missing. The wave merge must unwrap the `en.common` wrapper and merge the children into the central `common` namespace (do not copy the wrapper). Translate for fr, rw, sw. Interpolation tokens are shown literally in the values.

integrity.title: Data integrity
integrity.subtitle: The checks look for references that point at a row that is not there, references that do not hold an id, learners without a class group and ids that are used twice. Nothing is changed until you agree to a fix.
integrity.notConnectedTitle: The data layer is not connected
integrity.notConnected: The checks read the canonical tables of the new data layer, which is not connected to this page yet.
integrity.clean: The checks found nothing. Every reference of the canonical tables resolves.
integrity.applyMessage: {{count}} changes will be written to the database. Every change is recorded in the audit trail.
